## merra-accounting — Copilot Instructions

This is the main reference file for AI coding agents working on the merra-accounting monorepo.

---

## Repository Structure

This is a **monorepo** with two main directories:

- **`backend/`** — Java 25 Spring Boot 4.0.5 multi-module Maven backend
- **`web/`** — Angular 20.x frontend application

---

## Detailed Instructions

The detailed instructions have been split into two focused files:

### Backend (Spring Boot / Java)

See [backend-instructions.md](backend-instructions.md) for:

- Multi-module Maven architecture
- Build & run workflows
- Environment and configuration
- Key patterns & developer notes
- Java/Spring Boot documentation rules

### Frontend (Angular)

See [frontend-instructions.md](frontend-instructions.md) for:

- Angular 20.x setup and development server
- SCSS styling guidelines
- Angular Material v20 component usage
- Standalone component structure
- Routing, testing, and code generation

---

## When Editing These Files

- Update [backend.instructions.md](backend.instructions.md) for backend/Java/Spring Boot changes
- Update [frontend.instructions.md](frontend.instructions.md) for frontend/Angular changes
- Keep instructions concise and examples current
- Ask the repo owner if you need infra credentials or CI details
